gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with an unformed road and running in a south-easterly direction for about 160 metres where it terminates at its junction with WANG YIP STREET WEST as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/YL/R36A.

There will be future extensions at both ends of this street.
